name: define-flow
description: Define a test flow by doing it: an agent-led session that builds a spec step by step in a live browser — the agent proposes each step, executes it immediately, and the user asserts the real outcome before the next step is defined. Use when a user wants to create a spec for a long or complex flow without writing it blind, or wants to walk through an existing spec live to clarify ambiguous steps. Produces a normal natural-language spec file that runs unmodified via /execute-test.
